what_are_cookies.title: What are cookies?
what_are_cookies.description: A cookie is a small text file that a website stores on your computer or mobile device when you visit the site. Cookies can be used by websites to improve the user experience.
what_are_cookies.host_domain: Host domain cookies are cookies stored by the website you are currently visiting. Only this site can read them. Additionally, the site may use external services that also store their own cookies, known as third-party cookies.
what_are_cookies.persistent: Persistent cookies are cookies stored on your computer that do not automatically delete after closing the browser, unlike session cookies which do.
what_are_cookies.purpose_1: Their purpose is to allow the website to retain information about your settings (like username, language, etc.) for a set time.
what_are_cookies.purpose_2: This way, you don't have to re-enter them during one visit to the website.
what_are_cookies.purpose_3: Cookies may also be used to compile anonymized statistics about our website usage.

manage_cookies.title: How can you manage cookies?

adjust_settings.description: Modify your cookie storage settings and permissions

remove_cookies.title: Remove cookies from device
remove_cookies.description_1: By clearing your browsing history in your browser, you can delete all cookies stored on your device. This removes all cookies from all visited websites.
remove_cookies.description_2: Note, however, you may lose some saved information (e.g., saved login data, website preferences).

block_cookies.title: Blocking cookies
block_cookies.description: Most modern browsers can be set to block all cookies from being stored on your device; however, you may have to adjust some preferences manually on each visit. Some services/features may also not function properly (e.g., logging in).

how_to_shop.title: How to Shop
how_to_shop.intro: Shopping on this site is simple, but we have prepared a guide for you on how to do it:
how_to_shop.step_1:
In the product list, find the product you are interested in.

After clicking on the product, you can read a detailed description or view photos of the product.
how_to_shop.step_2: If you decided to buy a specific product, choose one of the offered variants or color combinations and then click the "Add to cart" button and fill in the form with your requirements for the manufactured product.
how_to_shop.step_3:
At any time, you can go to your shopping cart by clicking the shopping cart icon on the top right panel.

In the cart, you can adjust its contents and make changes (change quantity, requests, note for the seller).
how_to_shop.step_4: When you are satisfied with your selected products in the cart, you can proceed to edit delivery details for the order using the "Continue to delivery details" button.
how_to_shop.step_5: Next, you will have the option to log in, register, or continue with a "one-time order" without registration. After clicking, a form with delivery details will appear to be used for order processing. After filling in your delivery details, you can proceed to select the shipping method and payment method using the "Continue to shipping" button.
how_to_shop.step_6: After selecting the shipping and payment method, you can proceed to the summary of your order using the "Continue to summary" button.
how_to_shop.step_7:
On this page, you can check your order contents and all entered data before submission.

If you find a mistake, you can go to edit the respective section using the "Edit" button shown near that section.
how_to_shop.step_8:
Read our Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions.

Express your consent by checking the boxes "I agree with the Privacy Policy" and "I agree with the Terms and Conditions."
how_to_shop.step_9: Then you can submit a binding order by clicking the "Submit order with payment obligation" button.
how_to_shop.step_10:
We will inform you about further steps and order status by email messages to the email address you provided in the "Delivery details" section.

You can track your order status anytime at the "Order status" page.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: We've compiled the most important information to help you get the most out of your craft business platform.
faq.stillText: Our team is here to help you choose the perfect plan for your craft business and answer any questions about features, pricing, or implementation.

startHobby.question: Can I start with the Hobby plan and upgrade later?
startHobby.answer: Absolutely! Start with our free Hobby plan to test the waters. You can upgrade to Growth or Pro at any time as your business grows. All upgrades take effect immediately, and we'll prorate any billing differences.

freeIncludes.question: What's included in the free Hobby plan?
freeIncludes.answer: The Hobby plan includes everything you need to start: a basic storefront, up to 10 products, Craftorea.com subdomain, mobile responsive design, email support, and basic SEO optimization. Perfect for testing your craft business idea!

variants.question: What are product variants and how many do I need?
variants.answer: Product variants are different options for the same product (like sizes, colors, or materials). The count of variants is calculated by multiplying your options together - for example, 2 colors × 3 sizes = 6 variants. The Growth plan includes up to 20 variants per product, while Pro offers up to 1000 variants - perfect for complex product catalogs with many customization options.

multiLanguage.question: Do you offer multi-language support?
multiLanguage.answer: Multi-language support is available exclusively with the Pro plan, allowing you to translate your entire store and reach international customers. This feature is essential for expanding your craft business globally.

paymentMethods.question: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.answer: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfers for Pro plans. All payments are processed securely with industry-standard encryption. No setup fees - you only pay the monthly or yearly subscription fee.

exceedLimits.question: What happens if I exceed my product limits?
exceedLimits.answer: We'll notify you when you're approaching your limits and suggest upgrading to the next tier. You can also temporarily exceed limits with reasonable overage rates, but we recommend upgrading for the best experience and additional features.

customDevelopment.question: Can I get help with custom development?
customDevelopment.answer: Custom development is included with the Pro plan. Our team can build specific features and integrations tailored to your business needs. This includes API integrations, custom workflows, and specialized craft business tools.

compare.subtitle: How a maker-first platform stacks up against the big general-purpose e-commerce players.
compare.intro: Shopify and Shoptet are excellent platforms — for the right kind of store. Below is a constructive look at where Craftorea gives makers and artisans a real edge, a feature-by-feature table, and an honest note on when one of the others might serve you better.

advantages.title: Where Craftorea is ahead
advantages.subtitle: Six things makers get out of the box that elsewhere require apps, paid add-ons, or an agency.

madeForMakers.title: Built only for makers
madeForMakers.description: Shopify and Shoptet serve every kind of store, from dropshipping to groceries. Craftorea is designed around handmade businesses: made-to-order workflows, gift add-ons, care labels for textiles, priority order processing, and orders from Etsy, SAShE, markets and your own web store all in one dashboard.

allInclusive.title: One price, everything included
allInclusive.description: A typical Shopify store pays for the plan plus a premium theme plus a stack of monthly apps; Shoptet sells many features as paid add-ons. Craftorea plans (free, €39, €99) include every feature of the tier — with no setup fees and no platform fee on your sales.

personalization.title: Personalization built in
personalization.description: Buyer-entered custom text (engraving, dedications), priced options, gift-wrap add-on products, photo uploads for framed products, and up to 1,000 variants per product are part of the platform. On Shopify, the same setup usually means a personalizer app for up to $49/month — sometimes with its own fee per order.

invoicing.title: Invoicing accountants love
invoicing.description: Invoices with sequential numbering, credit notes, and a scan-to-pay QR code are generated automatically and sent in your customer's language. Export a whole month for your accountant or push invoices to SuperFaktúra — no third-party invoicing app needed.

euCompliance.title: EU compliance by default
euCompliance.description: Versioned terms, GDPR and complaints policies are published as PDFs and attached to every order confirmation automatically. The EU 14-day right of withdrawal is handled end to end — including the statutory exception for made-to-order goods. Elsewhere, this is your job.

multiLanguage.title: Truly multi-language stores
multiLanguage.description: Run one store in up to seven languages — products, categories, banners, legal documents, order emails and even invoices follow your customer's language. Shopify relies on a translation app with limits; on Shoptet, foreign languages are a paid add-on or a separate shop per market.

table.title: Feature-by-feature comparison
table.subtitle: The short version: what's built into Craftorea versus what needs apps, add-ons or workarounds elsewhere.

paidPlans.name: Paid plans
paidPlans.tooltip: Advertised base subscription prices, before themes, apps, add-ons and payment processing costs.

salesFee.name: Platform fee on your sales
salesFee.tooltip: Craftorea charges a subscription only — you connect your own payment gateway and the platform never touches your revenue. Shopify adds an extra fee of up to 2% when you don't use Shopify Payments.

personalization.name: Product personalization
personalization.tooltip: Buyer-entered custom text, priced options, gift add-ons and photo uploads for made-to-order products.

variants.name: Product variants
variants.tooltip: Variant counts are options multiplied together (e.g. 5 colors × 4 sizes × 2 materials = 40 variants). Craftorea Pro supports up to 1,000 per product.

etsyOrders.name: Etsy orders & invoicing
etsyOrders.tooltip: Craftorea imports paid Etsy orders in real time, shows them next to your web orders and can invoice them automatically.

customDevelopment.name: Custom development
customDevelopment.tooltip: The Craftorea team builds features and integrations tailored to your shop as part of the Pro plan.

multiLanguage.name: Multi-language storefront
multiLanguage.tooltip: Craftorea Pro translates products, categories, banners, documents, emails and invoices. Shopify's free translation app auto-translates at most two languages; Shoptet requires a paid add-on or a separate shop per market.

invoicing.name: Invoice generation
invoicing.tooltip: Sequential numbering, credit notes, QR payment codes, customer-language PDFs and SuperFaktúra integration — built in.

accountingExport.name: Accounting export
accountingExport.tooltip: One-click monthly export in a format Slovak accounting software imports directly.

euWithdrawal.name: EU 14-day withdrawal
euWithdrawal.tooltip: Statutory withdrawal handling: eligibility windows, partial withdrawals, made-to-order exceptions, forms and confirmation emails.

table.disclaimer: Based on publicly available information about Shopify and Shoptet as of August 2026. Features and prices change and may vary by country and plan — always check the vendors' sites for current details. Shopify and Shoptet are trademarks of their respective owners; neither is affiliated with Craftorea.

fair.title: When another platform is the better fit
fair.subtitle: A comparison is only useful if it's honest — here is when we would point you elsewhere.

shopify.title: Shopify: scale and app depth
shopify.description: If you run a large multi-channel operation, need point-of-sale hardware in retail stores, or depend on a very specific stack of third-party tools, Shopify's ecosystem of thousands of apps, themes and agencies is unmatched.

shoptet.title: Shoptet: broad Czech e-commerce
shoptet.description: If you sell a wide general product range mainly on the Czech market and live off local price-comparison feeds and marketplace integrations, Shoptet's deep local ecosystem is a solid, proven choice.

fair.closing: But if your business is your craft, Craftorea was built for exactly you.

cta.title: See the difference for yourself
cta.subtitle: Start free, add your first products and judge Craftorea by your own store — not by a table.
